content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Billboard advertising, broadband internet and insurance; no sports franchise, ballpark or live game ticketing."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Golf courses and golf entertainment venues; different sport and no professional team or ballpark."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Supermarkets, pharmacy and fuel retail selling groceries to households; unrelated to live sports entertainment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Concert promotion and ticketing platform serving artists; sports is only one end market, with no owned franchise."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Bowling and arcade entertainment centers; recreational venues rather than a professional sports franchise."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Arena and theatre venue operator hosting concerts and shows; does not own a sports team or its own ballpark."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Vacation ownership sales and resort management; a timeshare business unrelated to sports or ballpark operations."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Upscale hotel and resort ownership serving travelers and meetings; no sports franchise or event-driven fan business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Destination attractions, lodges and guided national park tours; tourism rather than professional sports."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas casino resorts earning gaming revenue; gaming and hospitality differ fundamentally from baseball operations."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Select-service hotel ownership selling room nights to travelers; no sports team, ticketing or media rights."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Movie theatres and hotels; film exhibition and lodging, not a sports franchise or stadium with media rights."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Florida land development, residential lots and timber; real estate and hospitality rather than sports entertainment."}]}
